title: [sweep] v18.4.0 release test sweep
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czj9tecb4nj5MfUyYk

Filing gate: **③ a maintainer-directed task.** On 2026-11-12 22:57Z the maintainer approved the 18.4.0 release plan, 「全部照办」, which includes this acceptance sweep on the release candidate, and the target to release 18.4.0 within about 24 hours.
Business reason: 18.4.0 ships through the Version Packages PR #29963 (about 1170 pending changesets, 460 with `Clause-②: yes`). These runs are the release's evidence that the standing smoke, the 18.4 capabilities and the 18.3.0 → 18.4.0 upgrade path hold at the release head.
Reader: the lane that owns `docs/qa/platform-checklist/**` (`domain:devx`) for every checklist-accuracy line parked here; the release decision reads §0.
Dedupe (open and closed): searched `[sweep] v18.4.0 release test sweep`; no 18.4 anchor exists. The nearest are #27377 (18.3.0, closed) and the early 18.4 probes #32093, #32102 (qa#2, closed) and #32135 (qa#1, open), which this wave re-judges.

This card is the **wave anchor** for the 18.4.0 release-candidate sweep. RUNNER's extraction obligation (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md`) applies:
- checklist-accuracy findings, fixture gaps, `partial` coverage gaps and not-run hand-overs close out **here**;
- product defects are extracted as their own cards and listed in §2;
- run records are `qa-run` issues that hang off this card by number.

## Plan

**Round 1** on current `main` @ `5fb79bc010cc9ab749dc29bfe44c83ef19f3dd11` (2026-11-12), Console built in-tree from the same commit. Three records:

| record | selector | items |
|---|---|---|
| R-P0 | `priority:P0` | 24 |
| R-184 | `since:v18.4` (includes the upgrade set `release-18.4.0-w1-upgrade`: `platform-core.activation-ledger-package-key-upgrade`, `platform-core.stored-reference-package-backfill-upgrade`, `cli.migrate-stored-references`, on an 18.3.0-written database) | 65 (54 runnable, 11 carrying a `blocked` marker) |
| R-OWED | `release-18.4.0-w2-owed` (`scripts/qa/retest-owed.mjs`, 19 rows at 2026-11-12T23:11Z; 8 of them sit in the two sets above and are judged there) | 19 |

**Round 2** on the frozen release sha once it exists: every round-1 FAIL, plus every item touched by the p0 fixes #32590, #32595, #32604, #32666, #32754 and #32230 (`touched:` selector against the round-1 subject).

## 0. The wave at a glance

Round 1, subject `main` @ `5fb79bc0` (2026-11-12), Console built in-tree:

| record | selector | result |
|---|---|---|
| #32953 | `priority:P0` | 24/24 · 19 PASS / 4 PARTIAL / **1 FAIL** / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN |
| #32940 | `since:v18.4` (with the upgrade set) | 65/65 · 42 PASS / 1 PARTIAL / 11 FAIL / 11 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN |
| #32949 | `release-18.4.0-w2-owed` | 11/11 · 6 PASS / 5 PARTIAL / 0 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN |

- **The P0 FAIL is a regression** (#32955): a non-admin approver cannot open an approval request; rule 7 verify agrees and traces it to #32428.
- **Upgrade 18.3.0 → 18.4.0:** 3/3 PASS on a real 18.3.0-written database (#32094, #32095, #32096 hold).
- **Retests:** every owed and earlier-run fix card re-judged holds: #32111, #24784, #32141, #31488, #32138, #32156, #32139, #32140, the 13 cards behind #32949, and #32112, #32106.
- No security finding.

Round 2 (frozen release sha): pending.

## 1. Checklist-accuracy findings and fixture gaps

Parked here at each record's close-out. The full text is in each record body and its runner comments.

**Partial coverage (not-run halves)**
- #32953: access-security.rls-both-sides acceptance[5] (blocked(dependency, #7463)) · access-security.crud-permission-matrix acceptance[5] (blocked(dependency, #23267)) · integration-system.datasource-credential-refusal-matrix acceptance[0] (build door, connector inline-auth door not driven) · records-forms.crud-roundtrip acceptance[6] readonly half (blocked(fixture)).
- #32940: access-security.ai-service-account-agent-ceiling clause 1 reads a session-only face with a key; re-point to admin `POST /security/explain`. 11 items blocked by their ledger markers (multi-replica ×6, Oracle ×2, SQL Server, AI chat Cloud/EE, locale-scoped seed).
- #32949: integration-system.email-template-render acceptance[7] no-provider arm · identity-auth.auth-method-matrix SSO and device variants · studio-authoring.expression-editors, ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason and ux-conventions.labels-over-machine-names (only the retest rows re-driven).

**Runner tooling**
- `scripts/qa/qa-fixture.mjs walled-boot` spawns `objectstack dev` without `--no-compile --no-watch` (about line 335): on a shared checkout it rewrites the showcase artifact and starts a watcher (#32953).
- `qa-fixture contributor-member` has no `--position` flag; the approvals persona needs a separate `showcase_finance` POST (#32953).
- plugin-email testkit `startFakeSmtp` takes no port option (#32949).

**Item text (re-point or refresh)**
- #32953: approvals.account-app-entry clauses 3–4 (request opens under the record-owning app since #32850; picker offers 简体中文 `zh-Hans`) · platform-core.builtin-apps-nav-render (Setup has 48 leaves) · cli.organization-ownership-ceremony (A-3 and A-2 of #32102 still open) · default-org steps[0] needs `--no-seed-admin` · walled-environment knownGaps[0] stale · no-active-org steps[8] and acceptance[4] · boot-health steps[3] · cli.dev-boot-contract steps[5], [8], [9] · studio-authoring.first-run-loop steps[6] · records-forms.crud-roundtrip delete and search locations.
- #32940: about 20 notes (read_file field host object, ADR-0146 D2 fixture renames, mock OIDC IdP recipe, 405 `Allow`, SCIM bucket key, pin counts, `homeAmount` inside `currencyConfig`, `serve --dev` for address grammar C4, and others).
- #32949: automation.trigger-status-contract acceptance[5] stale arm · notify-inbox-delivery telemetry DB · auth-method-matrix acceptance[9] needs `?token=` · error-envelope-ledger INVALID_FILTER face ruling · labels-over-machine-names acceptance[0] carve-out per ruling A on #32106.

**Observations, not scored** (#32953): Setup Audit Log page draws raw `record_id` for user rows; a stale 401 saved-views toast over the login form; Home "My work" untranslated flow label in zh; MCP `get_record` on an RLS-hidden row answers prose without a coded envelope.
